fato_historico: 1866: At the age of 18, Vinnie Ream becomes the first and youngest female artist to receive a commission from the United States government for a statue (of Abraham Lincoln).
energia_do_dia: Today, your adventurous spirit may feel a surge of youthful ambition. Just as history remembers a young visionary who sculpted greatness with her own hands, you might find that your creative confidence is at its peak. Consider pouring your energy into a new project, as it is a good time to carve out your unique legacy.
frase_do_dia: Your inner vision has the power to shape the world around you.
significado_numero: Representing the early bloom of talent and bold new beginnings.
conselho: Trust your creative instincts and take that first brave step today.
